# SEO-441: Relate each location node to its parent organization

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

A location's structured-data node names the organization it belongs to, and that organization resolves to the site-level node rather than being repeated as an unrelated object on each location page.

## Rationale

Without the relation each location reads as an independent business, so a graph describing one company with several branches describes several companies instead.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site",
    "local_business"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Reference the organization by its stable identifier from every location node instead of restating the organization's properties, so one edit to the organization reaches every branch.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Parse location nodes and confirm each names a parent organization whose identifier resolves to the site-level node.
- Evidence: `JSON_LD`, `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: none.

- Search surfaces: `LOCAL_SEARCH`, `GOOGLE_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
